item.title: Can Solberg extend 2026 win streak on home snow at WRC Rally Sweden?
item.description: Oliver Solberg starts this weekend’s Rally Sweden leading the FIA World Rally Championship points. But with that lead comes the challenge of starting the opening leg first and playing the role of road sweeper on what promises to be one of the fastest all-snow events in WRC history.

item.title: Verstappen slams 2026 F1 ruleset as ‘Formula E on steroids’
item.description: Max Verstappen heavily criticized the level of driving enjoyment from the new Formula 1 cars that have been introduced for 2026, describing them as more like Formula E and saying he needs to find the cars fun to stay in the sport.
